releaseNotes:
• Real Apple Liquid Glass: Full-lens optical refraction that visibly bends and magnifies text and album covers behind the dock
• Optical Micro-Frost (2dp): Eliminated heavy 24dp blur soup so underlying typography remains crisp, sharp, and legibly distorted through the convex glass lens
• Deep Refraction & Displacement Curve: Calibrated refraction to 0.65f and displacement curve to 0.55f across the full capsule with 0.045f chromatic prism fringe
• Pure Glass Transmission: Stripped all opaque white overlay veils for 100% optical clarity
• Preserved Button Architecture: Feed active pill, Stats, Playlists, and circular Search satellite intact
• Permanent Background & Lock-Screen Playback: Continuous foreground lifecycle, dedicated WakeLock, WifiLock, and pre-warmed streams
